result_text:
I changed `all_files.zip` packaging in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so it no longer uses hardcoded file names. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed-aspect config, so the fix itself is untested.

The zip code now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) from the analysis results. It gets each entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That's the same call that names the loose `aspect_*.txt` files, so the zip looks up each file under the name it was written with.

With the default config the entries are the same five names in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The earlier read failure no longer happens, so `git-history.zip` should be written too when `git-history.txt` exists.
